kong-movie-fan.line: Most gorilla sofas are prints on foam. Kong is a 2.5 mm Q235 welded frame rated to 200 kg — the meme, engineered.
kong-movie-fan.source: Kong PDP(2026-09-30 抓取):钢架/承重/FUZZ-LAB-2024-01

kong-movie-fan.line: Serialised inspection report SH2024-0945 travels with your crate — your unit's recorded test, not a marketing claim.
Clay form, welded steel core, hand-sewn fur — built in our own Shanghai atelier. No OEM, no catalog, no second Kong.
kong-movie-fan.source: Kong PDP FAQ:手工/独占原创/OEM 否定

plush-comfort-collector.line: 45 kg/m³ cold-cure foam shaped in its final form — it keeps the cloud without going flat.
Seat height tuned to 38 cm: gorilla-lounge geometry you sink into, not perch on.
Three collector skins — full-grain leather, short velvet, long faux fur — one hand-sewn per piece.
